game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt, a dusty bone crypt: the torchbearer must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Break Out: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt: a dusty bone crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Bone Crypt, repeat each round: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted. Each round, a new glowing mushrooms challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the alert value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 340 points of glowing mushrooms by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Break Out
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Break Out' (Week 4 slot 10), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Bone Crypt'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against slime blobs in Bone Crypt.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 34 seconds.
